title: Isaac and Rebekah
description: Abraham's servant is sent to Aram to find a wife for Isaac. At the well, he asks for a sign, and Rebekah fulfills it by giving water to him and his camels. Her family lets her go, and she becomes Isaac's wife.

versions.title: Isaac and Rebekah
versions.description: Abraham's servant finds Rebekah as a wife for Isaac, guided by God's providence at the well.
